scientific_question: Does a Love-Otto spatial fragmentation/cohesion metric measured in autumn contain incremental information about later elk demography beyond the immediately preceding demographic state and contemporaneous spatial scale?
novelty_boundary: This is a first wild temporal-validation attempt, not a claim that spatial early warning or demographic forecasting is unprecedented and not a general validation of Love & Otto across taxa.

known_before_lock: Love & Otto (2026) paper, code repository, and empirical/simulation conclusions
Ya Ha Tinda study descriptions, public aggregate demographic history, and annual GPS sample-size summaries
some published annual ground-count values from project reports
not_opened_before_lock_in_this_project: any fitted relationship between Love-Otto metrics and future Ya Ha Tinda demographic outcomes
exposure_firewall.implication: This is not outcome-blind preregistration. It is a fail-closed analysis contract fixed before the row-level movement-demography join and before any Love-Otto future-demography model fit.

sources.movement_study: Ya Ha Tinda elk project, Banff National Park, 2001-2020 (females)

movement_state.daily_snapshot_rule: For each individual-day choose the GPS fix nearest 12:00 local time; require absolute offset <= 6.5 h; ties choose the earlier timestamp; do not interpolate.
movement_state.sample_size_rationale: Love & Otto simulation code explicitly evaluates n=10,50,75,100,500; n=10 is therefore the frozen minimum rather than a result-dependent threshold.

fixed_n_standardization.deterministic_subsample_rule: Sort individual IDs by SHA256(date|replicate_index|individual_id) and take the first 10; average metrics across the 100 deterministic subsamples.

movement_state.annual_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of eligible daily fixed-n metric values across the frozen autumn window. This is a predeclared annual compression introduced for the Ya Ha Tinda future-year forecast; Love & Otto's Bathurst case computed and plotted daily CV time series and did not define this annual mean.
movement_state.contemporaneous_scale_baseline: Arithmetic mean pairwise distance, computed on the same fixed-n subsamples and averaged across eligible days.
movement_state.timestamp_semantics: Movebank timestamps are UTC by provider definition. An explicit offset is accepted; timezone-naive timestamp strings are accepted only for an input whose provenance is explicitly documented as a Movebank export/redistribution and are interpreted as UTC.
movement_state.schema_amendment_status: locked before demographic outcome rows were opened; acquisition-format clarification only
movement_state.love_otto_empirical_sampling_note: The Bathurst 2020 case filtered the fall dataset to at least 8 distinct animals, while the published simulation programme explicitly evaluated n=10,50,75,100,500. The Ya Ha Tinda protocol retains its already-frozen conservative n=10 minimum and does not lower it to 8 after this audit.

primary_outcome.name: following_late_winter_calf_cow_ratio
primary_outcome.timing: February-March following the autumn movement window
primary_outcome.target_mapping: autumn calendar year t predicts calf:cow ratio measured in late winter t+1
primary_outcome.baseline_state: the preceding late-winter calf:cow ratio measured before the autumn t movement window

primary_models.estimator: ordinary least squares; no hyperparameter tuning
primary_models.standardization: Each predictor is standardized inside each rolling-origin training fold using the training-fold arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1); the held-out year is transformed with those training values only.
primary_models.validation: rolling-origin one-step-ahead; first 7 eligible annual observations are the initial training set, then predict each later eligible year using only earlier eligible years
primary_models.positive_decision: detected_incremental_future_information only if M1 has lower RMSE and lower MAE than M0; otherwise no_detected_incremental_future_information
primary_models.no_significance_upgrade: The single-herd annual denominator is too small for a general inferential claim; the result remains a bounded temporal-transfer test even if prediction improves.
primary_models.singular_fold_rule: Fail closed if any frozen predictor has zero/invalid training-fold sample SD or if the OLS normal equations are singular; do not drop predictors or regularize post hoc.

prespecified_sensitivities.metric_family: After the primary cvratio result is recorded, repeat M1 separately with cvpop and cvind; do not select the best metric as a replacement primary.
prespecified_sensitivities.full_sample_metric: Repeat annual metrics without fixed-n subsampling using every eligible individual; this is a sampling-sensitivity analysis only.
prespecified_sensitivities.current_abundance_subset: Where a same-era minimum population count is available, add log(current_count) to both M0 and M1 on the identical complete-case years.
prespecified_sensitivities.migration_composition: If source-defined annual migratory classifications are joinable without outcome-based recoding, add resident fraction to both M0 and M1; this tests whether cvratio is merely a proxy for known migration composition.

minimum_count_growth.gate: Run only if at least 6 complete movement-and-consecutive-count transitions exist after the frozen movement gates.
minimum_count_growth.status: secondary descriptive; cannot replace the primary recruitment endpoint

adult_female_survival.gate: Use only a source-defined herd-level annual survival field if one exists. Do not invent a post-hoc weighted aggregation across migration tactics.

stop_rules: Do not lower the n=10 daily spatial-sample threshold.
Do not shorten the 30-day annual eligibility requirement after seeing which years survive.
Do not change the autumn window after opening outcome values.
Do not replace cvratio with whichever Love-Otto metric performs best.
Do not use ground-count series to rescue a failed primary demographic-file gate.
Do not use future years when fitting a rolling-origin forecast.
Do not tune a decline threshold or convert the continuous primary outcome to a binary event after results.
If fewer than 11 primary annual observations survive, report insufficient_temporal_replication and stop the primary model.

stop_result.note: Frozen demographic source ends too early for autumn t -> late-winter t+1 mapping to yield 11 observations; no model is fit.
